name: cattain-migrate
title: Cats with rules become Cattains, and their old threads are left alone
about: The daemon is stopped and its store replaced by one as Neko left it before Cattains (version 16, made by the debug daemon's --make-store-at, then three cats with rules and two old threads written with sqlite3). Started again, Settings ▸ Cattains lists the three; mochi's RULES.md and CREW.md hold its old rules and miso's RULES.md keeps its previous version; the old threads are unchanged, the one that had mochi now in mochi's crew.

steps.cmd: rm -rf "$data/neko.sqlite3" "$data/neko.sqlite3-wal" "$data/neko.sqlite3-shm" "$data/cattains" && "$daemon" --data-dir "$data" --make-store-at 16 && /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$data/neko.sqlite3" "INSERT INTO workspaces (id, name, created_ms, position) VALUES ('default', 'General', 1, 0); INSERT INTO cats (id, name, name_key, face, rules, previous_rules, rules_saved_ms, created_ms) VALUES ('cat_miso', 'miso', 'miso', 'ginger', 'QA-MISO-RULE: plan first.', 'QA-MISO-OLDER', 2, 1), ('cat_mochi', 'mochi', 'mochi', 'snow', 'QA-MOCHI-RULE: use British spelling.', NULL, NULL, 1), ('cat_tofu', 'tofu', 'tofu', 'calico', '', NULL, NULL, 1); INSERT INTO tasks (id, workspace_id, words, title, status, created_ms, activity_ms, last_read_ms, cat_id) VALUES ('task_old_docs', 'default', 'Old docs thread', 'Old docs thread', 'done', strftime('%s','now') * 1000 - 60000, strftime('%s','now') * 1000 - 60000, strftime('%s','now') * 1000, 'cat_mochi'), ('task_old_plain', 'default', 'Old plain thread', 'Old plain thread', 'done', strftime('%s','now') * 1000 - 50000, strftime('%s','now') * 1000 - 50000, strftime('%s','now') * 1000, NULL);"

steps.expect: After the migration the old threads are in the sidebar

sh.run: /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$data/neko.sqlite3" "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE (id = 'task_old_docs' AND cat_id = 'cat_mochi' OR id = 'task_old_plain' AND cat_id IS NULL) AND cattain = 0 AND title LIKE 'Old %' AND status = 'done'"

steps.expect: The old threads are untouched, and no thread was made for a Cattain nobody opened
mochi is a Cattain with its own thread
and its CREW.md, so its old threads read the same words

sh.run: /usr/bin/sqlite3 "$data/neko.sqlite3" "SELECT previous FROM cattain_files WHERE cat_id = 'cat_miso' AND name = 'RULES.md'"

steps.expect: miso's RULES.md is on disk and keeps its previous version
The old thread that had mochi is in mochi's crew
